records.name: KubeStateMetricsTimezonePanic
records.message: Clusters with CronJobs using .spec.timeZone may experience kube-state-metrics crash loops due to missing timezone data in the container image, breaking monitoring and potentially stalling upgrades.

records.name: MultiArchPayloadOSTreeSignature
records.message: The cluster upgrade on a standalone multi-arch cluster might be blocked on degraded MachineConfigPools. A 4.22 cluster enforces Sigstore signatures by ClusterImagePolicy which requires a recent version Skopeo. If ClusterImagePolicy takes effects before Skopeo is upgraded, the cluster upgrade is blocked.

promql.promql:
0 * group by (_id, invoker) (cluster_installer{_id="",invoker="hypershift"})
or
group by (_id, invoker) (cluster_installer{_id=""})

records.name: S390xContainerDataFailure
records.message: On s390x nodes, malformed container data prevents pod autoscaling, eviction, and metrics collection, affecting monitoring dashboards.

promql.promql:
topk(1,
  group by (label_kubernetes_io_arch) (kube_node_labels{_id="",label_kubernetes_io_arch="s390x"})
  or
  0 * group by (label_kubernetes_io_arch) (kube_node_labels{_id=""})
)

records.name: PortworxKernelModuleBuildFailure
records.message:
Clusters running Portworx may have storage unavailable after upgrading to 4.22.9.
The RHCOS kernel version shipped with 4.22.9 (5.14.0-687.35.1.el9_8) is not
available in RHEL package repositories, preventing Portworx from building its
kernel module on upgraded nodes.

promql.promql:
group by (_id, name) (csv_succeeded{_id="",name=~"portworx-operator[.]v.*"})
or on (_id)
0 * label_replace(group by (_id) (csv_succeeded{_id=""}), "name", "portworx-operator not installed", "", "")
